As a 13-seat, L-shaped chef’s counter restaurant, we don’t have a dedicated private dining room, but we frequently host private hires and would be delighted to accommodate your group.

Private Hire Package

Time Slots:

Let me know if you have any further questions.

Best regards,
Humble Chicken.

subject: Re: Amplemarket pulling wrong names for email sequences
text:
Hello Joe, 

I have an update from our team. It looks like the lead 'Thibaut' had the email ' 
l@mistral.ai' in your CRM, but this email actually belongs to 'Lélio'. 

This caused Thibaut's data to appear on Lélio's LinkedIn profile, and when you scheduled the sequence, Thibaut's info was used for that email. 

In short, we used the correct email but paired it with the wrong name. Our team is investigating ways to improve name and email matching to prevent this in the future. 

Hope that clarifies!

Kind regards,

Medha
